title: Hookay Bharda Vaikhay Phuppiyan Di Lachari Sajjad Muhari
body:
Lut Karbala Ch Pay Gai
Aag Khaimeya Nu Laai
Ankh Khool Mera Bachra
Zainab Dayway Duhai
Sir Nangay Vekh Phupiyan
Vadh Gaiye Beemari
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Shaam Day Raavan Ch
Ruk Ka’afila Gaiyae
Gal Zakhmi Touk Bhari
Tey Sakina Lab Reyaay
Haye Unth Ton Degh Paiye
Meri Bhain Piyari
<<DIVIDER>>
Raawan tey Phuppiyan lay Kay
Aaya Ka’afla Salaray
Rat Vadh Gai Ankhan Di
Jadon Aya Vich Bazaray
Pathran Di Sir Tey Barish
Nalay Bheer Bazari
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbar e Shaam Day Vich
Ous Dam Si Larzahaya
Mumtaz Malika Izmat
Jadon Khutba Si Sunaya
Ghairat Day Shehnsha Di
Ratt Akhiyan Chon Jari
